dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you need that for?

dialogues.speaker: Tanamart
dialogues.text: To use as a weapon, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Tanamart
dialogues.text: I might just be a homemaker right now, but I used to be a mercenary with the Eremites, so I always feel uneasy without a weapon at home.

dialogues.speaker: Tanamart
dialogues.text: Peace is precious, but you must always be prepared for the worst.
